# Control matrix (generated view)

This page is generated from [`data/control_matrix.csv`](../data/control_matrix.csv), which is the source of truth. It links each toolkit control to related items in ISO/IEC 42001:2023, the EU AI Act and the NIST AI RMF 1.0.

Read the mappings as "related to", not "equivalent to". They are the author's professional judgement and are not an official crosswalk. Control names and item titles are paraphrased. See [sources and verification](sources-and-verification.md) before relying on any identifier. This is not legal advice.

The matrix holds 50 controls across 9 domains.
